names.note: Read out of the list in doxologia.ro's life of Theodotus of Ancyra for 18 mai: «Tecusa, Alexandra, Claudia, Fainia, Eufrasia, Matrona și Iulia».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Μαΐου, «Αγίες Τεκούσα, Αλεξανδρία, Κλαυδία, Φαεινή, Ευφρασία, Ματρώνα, Ιουλία και Θεοδότη οι Παρθενομάρτυρες από την Άγκυρα της Γαλατίας και Θεόδοτος ο Μάρτυρας», with the rank words and the place left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 6 ноября ст. ст., «Клавдия Анкирская (Коринфская), дева, мц.», with the rank and state words left off; the epithets the page gives are kept. The line itself gives the name in the genitive, «Клавдии».

feast.note: Her name page lists two days, «18 мая , 6 ноября». The 18 мая is the day the Greek and Romanian calendars keep her on and the day page for it was not read here, so it is recorded as a note and not as a second Russian feast; this folder's Russian row renders on 6 ноября ст. ст. only.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 ноября ст. ст. — «Мцц. Текусы , Александры , Полактии , Клавдии , Евфросинии , Афанасии и Матроны (III).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 18 mai — «Sfânta Hristina și cele 7 sfinte fecioare împreună cu ea»

attestations.note: The calendar's line for 18 mai does not name the seven virgins; it counts them, «cele 7 sfinte fecioare împreună cu ea». The names are read out of the life of Theodotus of Ancyra printed for the same day, which lists them — «Tecusa, Alexandra, Claudia, Fainia, Eufrasia, Matrona și Iulia» — and states «Aceste sfinte fecioare au pătimit în optsprezece zile ale lunii lui mai».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Μαΐου — «Αγίες Τεκούσα, Αλεξανδρία, Κλαυδία, Φαεινή, Ευφρασία, Ματρώνα, Ιουλία και Θεοδότη οι Παρθενομάρτυρες από την Άγκυρα της Γαλατίας και Θεόδοτος ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar already keeps her on, and it is plainly the same company: the virgin martyrs of Ancyra in Galatia, handed to the soldiers by the governor Theoteknos and drowned in the lake when they were kept pure. **The page disagrees with itself about how many they were, and that is recorded rather than resolved**: eight women are named in the calendar line and as head entries, and the verse over the narrative is headed «Εις τας επτά», for the seven, «Λίμνη γυναικών επτάς εμβεβλημένη». Nothing on the page reconciles the two counts and nothing here does either. **The eighth, Theodote, has no folder and is a new one in batch `el-05-18`.** **No year is printed for the women**, so no `dates` object is added; the Theodotus head entry on the same page carries «(; - 304)». **No hymn stands on this page**, only the synaxarion verses.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Petru, Dionisie, Paulin și al Sfântului Mucenic Teodot și al celor șapte», Glasul 4 — the one troparion the page prints for all the martyrs of the day, «celor șapte» being these seven

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received the crowns of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength, they cast down the tyrants and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ our God, save our souls.

death.note: Two readings on one page and neither is chosen. days.pravoslavie.ru prints «(III)» at the end of its line for 6 ноября ст. ст., «Мцц. Текусы , Александры , Полактии , Клавдии , Евфросинии , Афанасии и Матроны (III).», while the life behind five of the seven name pages says the company «жили во 2-й половине III века в городе Анкире» and «мученически скончались за Христа в начале IV века» — lived in the second half of the third century and died at the beginning of the fourth. The upper bound is the page's own: it dates the death of Theodotus, who took their bodies out of the lake after they were drowned, to «7 июня 303 или 304 года». Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder any year, so this is the first date it carries.
